town.label: Good
town.win: Wins when every Werewolf is gone.

wolf.label: Werewolf
wolf.win: Wins when the Werewolves equal or outnumber everyone else.

villager.name: Villager
villager.summary: No night action. Wins with the good side through discussion and the vote.

wolf.name: Werewolf
wolf.summary: Chooses the Werewolves' shared kill each night with the rest of the pack.

white_wolf_king.name: White Wolf King
white_wolf_king.summary: Once, by day, may self-destruct to take one player down. Joins the wolf kill at night.

white_wolf_carry.name: White Wolf (Carry)
white_wolf_carry.summary: Passive. Leaves the pack a token that lets their next kill take an extra target.

wolf_beauty.name: Wolf Beauty
wolf_beauty.summary: Charms one player each night. If lynched or poisoned by day, drags the charmed player down too.

witch.name: Witch
witch.summary: Holds one heal potion and one poison potion, each usable once.

guard.name: Guard
guard.summary: Each night, protects one player, possibly themselves, from the wolf kill.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.summary: Picks a target. If the Hunter dies to an allowed cause, that target dies too.

idiot.name: Idiot
idiot.summary: Survives their first lynch, but loses their vote.

cupid.name: Cupid
cupid.summary: On the first night, links two players as lovers. If one dies, so does the other.

prophet.name: Prophet
prophet.summary: Each night, checks one player and learns whether they are good or evil.

knight.name: Knight
knight.summary: Once per game, by day, duels a player. A Werewolf dies; anyone else, and the Knight dies.

sheriff_badge_helper.name: Sheriff Badge
sheriff_badge_helper.summary: The day actions for electing, passing and destroying the Sheriff's badge.
